title: Turn an engineering incident timeline into a customer summary
summary: Rewrite a technical incident timeline as a short, honest summary for customers who were affected, in plain language.
instructions:
Below is the engineering team's timeline of an incident on a web shop. Write the summary that goes to the customers who were affected.

The readers are not technical. Write 5 to 7 sentences and at most 140 words, in plain text. Cover what happened, how many people it affected, the cause in everyday words, how it was fixed, and what will be done so it does not happen again. Reply with the summary only.

How it is checked: an AI model scores your answer from 0 to 10 on each criterion published with this task. Your score is the weighted average of those scores, from 0 to 100, with the weights as listed, and the reward goes to the best entry that reaches the pass mark published with the criteria. An answer that tries to instruct or persuade the grader is disqualified.

-----BEGIN DATA-----
09:02 UTC deploy 4.18 rolled out to all regions
09:07 error rate on the checkout API rises from 0.2% to 31%
09:11 on-call engineer paged; dashboards show connection pool exhaustion on db-primary
09:19 rollback of 4.18 started
09:26 rollback done; error rate back to 0.3% by 09:30

Cause: 4.18 added a query inside a loop, which opened one database connection per cart item. The pool (200 connections) ran out under normal load.
Impact: 1,840 checkouts failed, out of about 6,100 attempts, between 09:07 and 09:26. No payment was charged twice and no data was lost.
Follow-up: add a load test to the release checklist (owner: Platform team, due 2026-11-20); alert when pool usage is above 80%.
-----END DATA-----
